scripts.prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production nodemon -r dotenv/config dist/main.js dotenv_config_path=.env.production
scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development nodemon -r dotenv/config src/main.js dotenv_config_path=.env.development
scripts.dev:watch: concurrently "pnpm build:watch" "cross-env NODE_ENV=development nodemon -r dotenv/config dist/main.js dotenv_config_path=.env.development"
